lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's nineteen? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 19? Nope!

lines.text: Add one over root k, for every k from one to one hundred.
lines.caption: Add 1/√k, for every k from 1 to 100.

lines.text: What's the greatest whole number at most this sum?
lines.caption: What's the greatest whole number at most this sum?

lines.text: Grow a square from area k to k plus one, by one thin gap.
lines.caption: Grow a square from area k to k + 1, by one thin gap.

lines.text: Each term, one over root k, beats two gaps!
lines.caption: Each term, 1/√k, beats two gaps!

lines.text: The gaps grow the side from one to root one hundred one. The total beats eighteen!
lines.caption: The gaps grow the side from 1 to √101. The total beats 18!

lines.text: The same trick from inside says: under nineteen.
lines.caption: The same trick from inside says: under 19.

lines.text: Round it down, and it's eighteen!
lines.caption: Round it down, and it's 18!

lines.text: Nineteen was the trap. It stays UNDER nineteen!
lines.caption: 19 was the trap. It stays UNDER 19!

lines.text: Did you get eighteen? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 18? Tell me below!
